title: Implement answer
description: The implementing agent's closing note: what it changed, what it left undone and what the owner must know. Posted to the issue, recorded with the attempt and written into the pull request.

implemented.description: What was implemented: one short text per change made, in the words a reviewer reads (the files changed are taken from git, so do not list them). An empty list means nothing was implemented.

left_undone.description: What was left undone: one short text per thing skipped or not checked, naming its follow-up where there is one. An empty list means nothing was left undone.

issues_discovered.description: What was discovered that the owner must know: one short text per item — a risk, a bug outside scope, a stale document. An empty list means nothing was discovered.
